resources.name: RMF parameter set (coupling constants and meson masses)

access.notes: Parameters from Table II of source paper (g_σN=6.3935, g_ωN=8.7207, g_ρN=4.2696, b=0.008659, c=-0.002421, m_σ=400 MeV, m_ω=783 MeV, m_ρ=769 MeV). These are public and should be hardcoded in the solver.

resources.notes: No external dataset or model is required; the solver alone produces all outputs.
